newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania 1996 sunflower crop seen at 1.3 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Romania 1996 sunflower crop seen at 1.3 mln tonnes.

text.p: Romania has begun its 1996 sunflower harvest and average yields indicate a crop of around 1.3 million tonnes, an agriculture ministry official said on Friday.
Ministry spokeswoman Aurelia Ioan said average yield so far was 1.51 tonnes per hectare, higher than initial ministry estimates of 1.29 kg.
"Of course, we don't expect the same average (per hectare) everywhere in the country but we count on a crop of some 1.3 million tonnes of sunflowerseeds," Ioan said.
Some 908,780 hectares were sown to sunflowers this year.
The 1995 sunflowerseed crop totalled around 930,000 tonnes.
The 1996 crop was expected to yield more than 420,000 tonnes of sunflower oil, enough to meet local demand and allow exports of some 200,000 tonnes, the ministry said.

Trade ministry sources said export licences would be granted for both raw and refined sunflower oil. Last year the ministry issued licences only for refined oil and not for other related products. --Adrian Dascalu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
